tldr: Russian drone attacks on Kyiv killed at least 12 people on the sixth consecutive night.
U.S. job openings increased slightly to 7.3 million, indicating continued strength in the labor market.
Andy Burnham has become the new Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, delivering his first address to the Commons.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite declined, with rising crude oil prices fueling inflation worries, which can negatively impact stock markets. Additionally, an investor noted a disconnect between AI valuations and revenue-growth forecasts, potentially contributing to caution in tech-heavy indices.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to its highest level since January 2025 due to concerns over higher oil prices stoking inflation. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, leading to rising oil prices, also contributed to inflation worries and a global bond sell-off.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, increased as the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite declined, reflecting a general rise in market caution and uncertainty following higher bond yields and inflation concerns.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate saw a slight increase, consistent with the upward trend in the 10-year Treasury yield observed over recent days.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

tech.summary: Macquarie University is replacing in-person psychology classes with an AI chatbot, online quizzes, and optional online tutorials, a move that critics within academia fear will lead to staff cuts and diminish the value of teaching roles.
Apple has announced that John Ternus has taken over as the company's new CEO, replacing Tim Cook as of September 1st.
Nvidia is officially launching DLSS 5 this week, requiring RTX 50-series GPUs for its AI upscaling technology, after a divisive announcement in March.

world.summary: Russia killed at least 12 people in and around Kyiv during a sixth night of drone attacks, with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stating that Moscow is exploiting a shortage of US-made Patriot interceptors.
German authorities are investigating reported explosives near the coal-fired Jänschwalde power plant in Brandenburg amidst increased scrutiny of Russia's activities on Europe’s eastern flank.

Qatar has indicated that efforts are underway to end the Iran-US war and facilitate the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, while accusing Israel of exploiting regional conflicts to impose new realities.
Andy Burnham delivered his first address as the new Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, promising "substantial change" and acknowledging his predecessor, Keir Starmer.

us.summary: U.S. job openings rose slightly to 7.3 million, indicating that the labor market remains robust despite higher costs for employers.
Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned after 18 months in the role, marking the latest in a series of leadership changes within the military.
The Supreme Court has permitted President Trump to continue the construction of a ballroom at the White House.

science.summary: An investigation by NPR and Boston University revealed that thousands of Americans die from heat every year, with official statistics significantly undercounting the actual toll.
NASA's newest space telescope, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, has successfully launched, aiming to explore cosmic mysteries and identify over 100,000 exoplanets.
